Firefox lets you display menus, notifications, messages and other parts of the Firefox interface in different languages.
{note}
'''Tip:''' To choose a language for displaying web pages, see [[Choose display languages for multilingual web pages]].

'''Note:''' If you don't see the {for not fx152}''Language'' section under the {menu General} panel{/for}{for fx152}{menu Languages} page{/for} in Firefox settings, or if you can't add new languages, make sure:
*You're using the [[Update Firefox to the latest release|latest version of Firefox]].
*You're connected to the internet.
*You're using Firefox (not Firefox Nightly or Developer Edition – see special instructions below).
{/note}

__TOC__

=Switch Firefox to another language=
You can switch languages at any time to display Firefox menus, notifications and messages in a different language.
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#*If you can't read the language Firefox is currently using, type '''about:preferences#languages''' in the adress bar to open the {menu Settings}{for not fx152}, then go to a section with a drop-down menu and language names.{/for}{for fx152} section {menu Languages} directly.{/for}
#{for not fx152}In the ''Language'' section of the {menu General} panel, choose a language in the drop-down menu{/for}{for fx152}Select {menu Languages} on the left and go to the ''Browser language'' section. Choose a language in the drop-down menus {menu Preferred languages} and {menu Fallback language}, if available{/for}.
#Restart Firefox.
;{for fx152}[[Image:fx152browserlanguage]]{/for}

{note} '''Note:''' Not all regional language variants are available in Firefox. If your preferred version is missing, try selecting the base language (such as English) or check the [https://www.firefox.com/download/all/ Firefox website] for languages available in each version.{/note}

{for not fx152} <!-- Fx152+ no longer exposes the below functionality separately; folded into the UI above -->
=Add languages to the Firefox interface=
Follow these steps to add more languages to Firefox.
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#In the ''Language'' section of the {menu General} panel, click {menu Search for more languages} in the drop-down menu.
#Click {menu Select more languages to add} and choose the languages you want to add, then click the {button Add} button.
#Use the {button Move Up} and {button Move Down} buttons to change the order, or {button Remove} to pull a language out from the list.
#Click {button OK} to save your changes.
{note}Firefox will display the first language as your default and will display alternate languages if necessary in the order they appear.{/note}
{/for}

=Set an order of preference for languages=
If a Firefox feature is not available in your top language, Firefox will display your next preferred language.
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#{for not fx152}In the {menu Language} section of the {menu General} panel, click {button Set Alternatives…} to open the ''Firefox Language Settings'' window{/for}{for fx152}In the {menu Language} page, go to the ''Browser language'' section and click the '''Fallback language''' drop-down menu, if avalaible{/for}.
#Select a language and use the {button Move Up} and {button Move Down} buttons to change the order, or {button Remove} to pull a language out from the list.

{note}'''Note:''' If you are using Firefox Developer Edition or Firefox Nightly, you will need to download a new copy in the language you wish to use from the [https://www.firefox.com/download/all/ Firefox website]. See the section below for further instructions.{/note}

=Change language in Firefox Nightly or Developer Edition=
Firefox Nightly and Developer Edition do not support changing the interface language through Settings. To use a different language:
#Go to the [https://www.firefox.com/download/all/ Firefox download page].
#Choose your version and preferred language.
#Download and install that version manually.

=Website translation behavior=
The language chosen also influences some defaults for content negotiation. To set your preference for languages requested from websites, see [[Choose display languages for multilingual web pages]].

The locale together with the regional settings of your operating system may also influence the language pairs and direction offered by [[Firefox Translations]].
